question: Should Control UI support message-level edit/regenerate as first-class branching actions, and should history-only typo edits be allowed to rewrite a persisted transcript without an agent run?
rationale: The requested modes imply different durable-history and session-branch semantics, so source-level implementation cannot safely choose the product contract on its own.

options.title: Adopt explicit branch actions
options.body: Define edit-and-reprocess and regenerate as transcript-preserving branch operations, with clear UI lineage and a dedicated protocol contract.

options.title: Support regenerate only
options.body: Add a bounded alternative-response action first and defer history editing until transcript-mutation semantics are approved.

options.title: Keep session-level fork only
options.body: Decline message-level controls for now and document the existing fork workflow as the supported alternative.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit branch actions
recommendation.body: Define edit-and-reprocess and regenerate as transcript-preserving branch operations, with clear UI lineage and a dedicated protocol contract.
